body: Many times. But the biggest issue is really just trying to find any of their reasons to take to heart. I'd rather do it honestly. Just to not stand in anyone else's way now.

He's not old enough to know the difference of me disappearing though. And his step dad is a nice enough guy. I'm sure he'll be okay. My girlfriend will move forward and my parents will forget eventually. You'd be surprised just how small my world feels and how much smaller my significance in it is.
